7.3.4 Reporting
Event IDs of security events are provided as symbolic name values by IdsM through IdsM.h. The EventId symbols of security events are the short name of the SwcServiceDependency of the BSW module (through the IdsM ECUC) prefixed with IdsMConf_ IdsMEvent_. See TPS_ECUC_02108 (AUTOSAR Specification of ECU Configuration [10] "2.4.5.2 Representation of Symbolic Names").
[SWS_BSW_00251] Values for Event IDs of security events are imported Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00493
⌈Values for Event IDs of security events are assigned externally by the configuration of the IdsM module.⌋
[SWS_BSW_00252] Report security events to IdsM Status: OBSOLETE Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00489
⌈The BSW Module shall report the detected security events to the Intrusion Detection System Manager (IdsM) using the service IdsM_SetSecurityEvent if this specific security event has been configured for this BSW Module. Std_ReturnType IdsM_SetSecurityEvent ( IdsM_SecurityEventIdType securityEventId)
⌋
Note that the configuration of security events is optional in the ECU Configuration of the BSW Modules.
[SWS_BSW_00253] Report security event context data to IdsM Status: OBSOLETE Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00491
⌈For reporting security events with additional context data the following BSW specific interface of IdsM shall be called: IdsM_SetSecurityEventWithContextData ( IdsM_SecurityEventIdType securityEventId, const uint8* contextData, uint16 contextDataSize)
.⌋
